notes: Requires CourtLine Backend 0.36.0-test.38. Install Backend first. All old shared Main and Viewer pairings are retired: scan the fresh single-use enrollment QR in Backend Device Management once per device. New devices start in Companion with Control access OFF. The Backend owner enables Control for that device, then the saved Backend PIN unlocks Control. There is no Control QR. Full close/restart returns to Companion; minimize/sleep preserves the current session. Switching to Companion requires confirmation. Turning Control access off preserves Companion; revoking App access ends the enrollment and requires administrator help and a fresh QR. Device names are optional owner-editable labels after automatic enrollment. Android Test Connection probes the entered vMix address and saves that exact address to Backend only after success; failed tests do not save, and conflicts/lock/save failures are reported. Backend PC Save behavior is unchanged. Backend controls consolidated; Refresh Stats Now replaces the old Export & Refresh Now label without changing behavior. Original Android signing identity maintained. IMPORTANT: existing iPad 1.0.6 is incompatible with Backend test.38 device sessions; rescanning alone cannot restore it. No iOS update is included and existing iPad release files are unchanged. Automated regression, real Backend HTTP protocol/UI integration and static phone/tablet layout checks passed. Physical Fire Tablet/Android QR preview/decode, cold/background lifecycle, native picker and installation acceptance remain pending.
